description: Figure 2, located on the left side of a two-plot pair, presents a bar chart titled “Recall@10” that illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. The horizontal axis displays four categories: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” representing the full model and its variants with one component removed. The vertical axis, labeled with values from 0.1 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1, quantifies the Recall@10 metric. The “Ours” bar, colored orange, reaches approximately 0.35. The “- critiquing” bar, in blue, is slightly lower at about 0.30. The “- scoring” bar, also blue, is the shortest, at approximately 0.18. The “- ranking” bar, blue as well, stands at roughly 0.24. The chart visually demonstrates that removing any component degrades performance, with the removal of “scoring” causing the most significant drop in Recall@10.
